entries.english:
Plaintiff: Schulthoff, tenant farmer, Stocklarn. Defendant: saddler J. A. Kleinegger, Soest; Heinr. Blaume, Berwicke; tenant farmer Loer, Stocklarn; Jakob Rosenberg, Soest. Subject: monetary claim arising from the sale of timber.

Also contains: timber-sale record, 1833.
